resting_hr.green: Optimal: Cardiovascular conditioning and resting heart rate are stable. Action: Continue routine mission tasks.
resting_hr.yellow: Warning: Elevated resting heart rate indicating cardiovascular strain or fatigue. Action: Pause current tasks, hydrate, and rest for 15 minutes.
resting_hr.red: Critical: Persistent tachycardia or cardiac strain! Action: Lie down immediately, monitor telemetry, and alert Mission Control.

blood_oxygen_spo2.green: Optimal: SpO2 levels optimal. Action: Maintain routine station operations.
blood_oxygen_spo2.yellow: Warning: Mild hypoxia indicator or cabin ventilation drop. Action: Check local module air flow and practice paced deep breathing.
blood_oxygen_spo2.red: Critical: Hypoxia risk! Action: Put on supplemental oxygen mask immediately and check suit/module pressure integrity.

exercise_compliance.green: Optimal: Full adherence to physical countermeasures schedule. Action: Keep up the excellent routine.
exercise_compliance.yellow: Warning: Falling behind on prescribed daily workout minutes. Action: Re-schedule missed training blocks into today's timeline.
exercise_compliance.red: Critical: Severe non-compliance with physical countermeasures! Action: Immediate mandatory physical conditioning session required.

body_temp.green: Optimal: Core body temperature is normal. Action: Maintain standard operations.
body_temp.yellow: Warning: Mild elevation in body temperature. Action: Increase fluid intake, rest, and monitor temperature trend over the next 2 hours.
body_temp.red: Critical: High fever or acute inflammatory/infection sign! Action: Isolate in quarters, take prescribed antipyretics if cleared, and contact Flight Surgeon immediately.

sleep_hours.green: Optimal: Sleep hygiene and duration are adequate. Action: Maintain normal circadian alignment.
sleep_hours.yellow: Warning: Sleep restriction detected (<6 hours). Action: Review pre-sleep lighting protocols and protect the 8-hour sleep window.
sleep_hours.red: Critical: Severe sleep deprivation affecting cognitive performance! Action: Take an immediate nap period and suspend critical operational decisions.

mental_health.green: Optimal: Behavioral health and mood are stable. Action: Maintain regular crew interactions.
mental_health.yellow: Warning: Isolation fatigue or declining mood score. Action: Schedule a private communication session with family.
mental_health.red: Critical: Severe psychological distress! Action: Speak with the crew commander or ground psychological team immediately.

dose_cum.green: Optimal: Cumulative radiation dose is well within NASA limits. Action: Continue routine operations and wear your dosimeter.
dose_cum.yellow: Warning: Cumulative radiation dose is approaching the limit. Action: Spend more time in the best-shielded area of the habitat and limit unnecessary exposure.
dose_cum.red: Critical: High cumulative dose or a solar particle event detected! Action: Move immediately to the storm shelter / best-shielded area and contact Mission Control.
